name: week
title: The flying week
subtitle: Trips booked, what would stop each one, and what needs chasing

sections.title: Schedule
sections.sql: select code,flight_date,first_std,status,client,aircraft,pic,route,pax,manifest,problems from v_schedule order by flight_date,first_std,code

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select kind,record,due,detail from v_attention order by due,kind,record

name: crew
title: Crew hours and currency
subtitle: Flight and duty time against the scheme, medicals, reviews, checks and recency

sections.title: Flight and duty hours
sections.note: Limits come from the limits table. Set them from your approved flight and duty scheme.
sections.sql: select crew,name,flight_7d,limit_7d,flight_28d,limit_28d,flight_365d,limit_365d,duty_7d,duty_limit_7d from v_crew_hours order by crew

sections.title: Currency
sections.sql: select crew,name,medical_expiry,medical_days,review_due,check_due,landings_90d,pax_current,types from v_currency order by crew

sections.title: Duty and rest findings
sections.sql: select rule,record,issue from v_compliance where rule like 'FTL-%' order by rule,record

name: fleet
title: Fleet status
subtitle: Hours to the next check, airworthiness reviews, defects and utilisation

sections.title: Aircraft
sections.sql: select code,type,base,status,hours,next_check_name,hours_to_check,arc_expiry,days_to_arc,open_defects,deferred_defects from v_fleet order by code

sections.title: Open and deferred defects
sections.sql: select d.code,a.code aircraft,d.raised_on,d.description,d.deferred,d.due_on from defects d join aircraft a on a.id=d.aircraft_id where d.cleared_on is null order by d.due_on nulls first,d.code

sections.title: Hours flown, last 90 days
sections.sql: select aircraft,count(distinct trip) trips,sum(air_hours) air_hours,sum(fuel_l) fuel_l from v_legs where logged and flight_date>=current_date-90 group by aircraft order by air_hours desc
